Anna — thanks, got the attachments and the quick overview. Looping in Karthik (tax/procurement lead) and Laura (payments) so we can confirm the minimal evidence and PO entity. Marissa on procurement ops will pick up the supplier profile afterwards.

Quick answers up front:
- We typically issue POs to "Redwood Inference, Inc." for services paid from the US entity unless contract/legal requires a local entity. Laura, confirm if EU ops should be used for this partner.
- For German suppliers, we accept the USt-IdNr (VAT ID) plus the VAT certificate PDF for reverse-charge handling. In some cases we also request a certificate of tax residency (local tax office) if the vendor requests treaty benefits for withholding.
- Invoice fields: vendor legal name, VAT ID, invoice date, PO number, line-level descriptions, net/ VAT amounts (if VAT applied). For SEPA payments please include IBAN + BIC.

Next steps for EuroWare: please confirm the exact legal entity name for the invoice and attach a signed supplier profile with bank details. Karthik — can you add any documentation checklist items we should request for EU vendors to avoid later holding payments?

Thanks,

Hi all — thanks for sharing the documents. Quick procurement/tax checklist for EuroWare (to avoid invoice holds / VAT disputes):

Required (to start PO/payment):
- Legal company name exactly as registered (for PO) — please confirm in writing.
- USt-IdNr / VAT registration certificate (good, we have the PDF).
- Signed supplier profile with bank account (IBAN + BIC) and remittance address.
- Contact person for invoicing and PO reconciliation.

If vendor wants to be VAT-exempt under reverse-charge for B2B EU services, we need:
- VAT ID on the invoice matching the certificate.
- Statement on invoice: "Reverse charge — Article 196 EU VAT Directive" where applicable.
- If Redwood requests, certificate of tax residency (Bescheinigung) to support cross-border VAT treatment.

Optional but helpful: sample invoice mapping to our PO fields (attach one). If vendor invoices from a different legal entity than the one on the VAT certificate, that will trigger additional due diligence and may delay payments.

Marissa, please open PROC-912 and set the onboarding priority to "standard"; ask EuroWare for the signed profile. Laura, can payments accept invoices sent to Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) while we evaluate whether an EU invoicing route is needed? If so, include steps to remit via SEPA where IBAN is present.

Karthik
